versions.content: The only exception is at the receiver side when retry is configured and due to an errone ous frame an AF with negative acknowledgement is sent and therefore it is waited for the retry frame(s). In this case, the timer CR will be reset by the erroneous frame.

The only exception is at the receiver side when retry is configured and due to an errone ous frame an AF with negative acknowledgement is Specification of FlexRay AUTOSAR Transport Layer AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 54 of 101 Document ID 601 : AUTOSA R_SWS_FlexRayAR TransportLayer sent and therefore it is waited for the retry frame(s). In this case, the timer CR will be reset by the erroneous frame.
